title: Vanishing of all redshift modes in Schwarzschild ringdown
summary: Several studies of black hole ringdown from particles plunging into black holes have identified contributions decaying at integer multiples of the surface gravity, called redshift modes, horizon modes, and direct waves. We show that, for Schwarzschild black holes, every one of these contributions has vanishing amplitude in the observable waveform. The cancellation follows from causality, which forces the source-integrated Green function to vanish on the light cone.
